description.en: Fukui Prefecture is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshū. Fukui Prefecture has a population of 737,229 and has a geographic area of 4,190 km2 .
description.zh-CN: 福井縣位處日本中部的北陸地方，面向若狹灣，縣廳所在地為福井市。福井縣可分為嶺北和嶺南兩塊地區。
